name: voicenotelog
author: inthedark.org
kirin
short: Log transcriptions of members' voice notes.
description: Port of Seina-Cogs' voicenotelog. Transcribes voice notes with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and posts them to a log channel. Needs ffmpeg on the host and a Google Cloud API key (`[p]set api google_speech api_key,<key>`). Reads the settings the original cog saved.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall Seina-Cogs' voicenotelog before loading this; its settings carry over. ffmpeg must be installed on the host. Set a Speech-to-Text key with `[p]set api google_speech api_key,<key>`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data. Voice notes are sent to Google Cloud Speech-to-Text to be transcribed.
